actions: Implement tighter ATR-based stop‑losses (e.g., 1.5 ATR) to reduce premature exits.
Reduce max position size to 10% of budget to improve liquidity.
Prioritize stocks with average daily volume > 1 M and tight bid‑ask spreads.
Use VWAP and opening‑range breakout filters; require confirmation on 5‑minute chart before entry.
Introduce a pre‑trade liquidity check: minimum $50k notional and <0.5% market impact.
Shift to a 2‑trade‑per‑day limit to focus on high‑conviction setups.
Maintain 75% capital deployment only after high‑conviction entries are identified.
strategy_overhaul.timeline: Re‑evaluate after next trading day; resume trading when win rate >5% and PnL positive.
